sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Indoor blower motor mismatch: the indoor motor horsepower does not match the unit capacity.
causes: Indoor motor horsepower does not match unit capacity
diySteps: Leave the furnace off. This is a configuration fault, not a filter or thermostat setpoint issue

Technician: check the unit size codes for the furnace or air handler in the configuration guide or the installation instructions. The code clears after the correct match is detected following a reset. The manual says to remove the thermostat from the system while applying power and reprogramming
proAdvice: E202 is a size-code mismatch, not E201 (lost communication) and not E203 (no capacity code selected). Call a licensed HVAC technician. Do not guess a unit size code.
